triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: his master, who was also perhaps his father—Fyodor Pavlovitch;

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: his master’s elder son, Ivan Fyodorovitch,

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: they would, in fact, have suspected the son of the murdered man, Dmitri Fyodorovitch.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: The charge is confirmed by three persons only—the two brothers of the prisoner

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: He was naturally very honest and enjoyed the complete confidence of his master

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: then his servant, Grigory, but he was almost killed himself;

triples.subject: Marfa Ignatyevna
triples.quote: the third person was Grigory’s wife, Marfa Ignatyevna,

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: The first person who cried out that Smerdyakov had committed the murder was the prisoner himself at the moment of his arrest

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: for the last two months he has completely shared our conviction of his brother’s guilt

triples.subject: Ivan Karamazov
triples.quote: The man is dead, I can throw the blame on him and save my brother.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: He did not run respectfully and timidly away from his father’s window, though he was firmly convinced that the object of his affections was with him.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: Most likely he killed him in anger, burning with resentment, as soon as he looked on his hated rival.

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Had it been Smerdyakov, for instance, murdering his master to rob him, he would have simply carried away the envelope with him

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: he heard behind him the servant cry out; the old man caught him, stopped him and was felled to the ground by the brass pestle.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: having killed him, probably with one blow of the brass pestle, and having convinced himself, after careful search, that she was not there

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: Supposing that he did agree, it would still follow that Dmitri Karamazov is the murderer and the instigator, and Smerdyakov is only a passive accomplice

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: As soon as he is arrested the prisoner instantly throws all the blame on Smerdyakov, not accusing him of being his accomplice, but of being himself the murderer.
